correction.reason: Measurement correction, not surface growth: the 2.3.0 baseline recorded only define()-registered tools. tower_mode and tower_control are registered directly by index.js, so the shipped surface was always 29 (#118). The recorder in host/tool-registry.js now covers both paths.

decisions.note: The component surface joins the budget with its history. 2.0.4 shipped four top-level rows (tower, tower-skills, preset-tower-worker, preset-tower-reviewer); 2.3.0 replaced them with one tower-bundle group row that still mounts the same four sections. This is a recorded contraction, not a free ratchet: the seed stays at 4 so any further move -- including the #121 growth back to individually toggleable optional rows -- must extend this chain with a dated decision.
